input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Our convenience exit is conditioned on open-ended early termination charges set entirely by Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments, with no cap in the Base Terms — a Customer-payable liquidated amount of unknown size. Redline caps those charges at three months' charges for the terminated Services as the sole amount payable on termination (our fallback); we credit that § 3.3 already disapplies them where IBM is the breaching party and that ordinary late-payment fees under § 4.2 are acceptable.

input.quote: IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES, PRODUCTS, DATA, APPARATUS AND SOFTWARE "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND
input.rationale: IBM warrants only reasonable care and skill plus compliance with laws applicable to its own business; there is no conformance warranty for Materials or Base Components (they are supplied "AS IS"), no warranty period and no stated remedy, and §§ 5.2/5.4 disclaim everything else including capacity, performance and secure operation. That fails the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund). Redline adds a 90-day conformance warranty with a re-performance/repair/refund remedy and carves the express warranties out of the disclaimers.

input.quote: Risk of loss for all Base Components shall at all times remain with IBM. Risk of loss for all Customer Components shall at all times remain with Customer.
input.rationale: No insurance obligation exists anywhere in the Agreement (a search for "insurance" returns nothing); § 14.12 allocates risk of loss but requires no coverage. For a vendor hosting our environment and processing personal data on our behalf (§ 14.18), that is our walk-away case. Redline inserts a short insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' comp) with certificates on request in the general terms.

input.quote: Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage.
input.rationale: The Base Terms contain no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume restriction (searches for "minimum", "commit" and "shortfall" return nothing); charges are for Services ordered, and § 11.5 places capacity planning with us without committing volumes. Any commitment would have to appear in an Order Form or Service Option Attachment, and our § 3.4 one-month convenience exit applies — we will confirm the Attachment A/Order Form terms when provided.

input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable.
input.rationale: Section 3.5 deals only with our payment obligations; nothing in the Agreement requires IBM to provide transition assistance, return our Content in a usable format, or delete it afterwards (the only "return" obligation runs against us, for Materials, under § 8.1). For a hosting agreement that is a material gap. Redline inserts a transition-assistance, data-return-within-30-days and certified-deletion paragraph into § 3.5, which already survives termination under § 14.2.
